single_diagnostic_question: Does the H99 force-at-terminal rule duplicate a broad deferred pair frontier across many terminal leaves, making the sum of terminal narrowphase pair evaluations exceed eager parent-to-child evaluation?
allowed_diagnostic: Inspect the child frontier and subdivision control flow.
Run one deterministic synthetic case that creates more than one terminal leaf and reports deferred observations, terminal-force invocations, and narrowphase pair evaluations.
Do not run any real candidate or Isaac process during this diagnostic.
expected_result: The code path and synthetic counters show multiple terminal-force invocations after deferral, with the same unresolved pairs evaluated independently in sibling terminal leaves.
failure_criterion: The diagnostic shows no duplicated terminal work or locates the elapsed time outside child frontier classification; in that case the next fix must target the measured alternative mechanism.
